patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient presents with a complaint of severe vulvar itching that has been gradually worsening over the course of the past year. She has attempted to use over-the-counter lubricants for relief with no substantial improvement. She reports severe pain during vaginal intercourse that has recently led to cessation of sexual activity.

Secondary_Symptoms: Use of over-the-counter lubricants with no relief

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Diet-controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypertension treated with hydrochlorothiazide, menopause occurred at 52 years of age.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Sexually active with her husband until recently due to discomfort.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies urinary symptoms, abnormal vaginal discharge, or rectal symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with chronic vulvar itching and discomfort.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: I’ve been dealing with severe vulvar itching that’s gradually worsened over the past year, and over-the-counter lubricants haven’t helped much. I also have painful intercourse, and it’s gotten bad enough that I stopped being sexually active.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t think I’ve noticed any small raised bumps with a dimple in the center. Mostly it’s intense itching of the vulvar area, along with painful intercourse that’s been getting worse over time.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed needing to urinate more often than usual. I mainly have the severe itching on the vulvar area and painful intercourse, and that discomfort has been steadily worsening over the past year.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling generally weak or lacking your usual strength lately?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t really felt generally weak or noticeably lacking my usual strength. It’s mainly the severe vulvar itching and the painful intercourse that have been steadily getting worse over the past year.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself or putting on your clothes lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any trouble dressing myself or putting on clothes. It’s really just the severe vulvar itching and painful intercourse that are bothering me most.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms. My main issue has been the severe vulvar itching that’s been gradually worsening, along with pain during intercourse.

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calf muscles when you walk that goes away once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any calf pain or cramping when I walk, and it doesn’t seem to be relieved by stopping and resting. My main problem is still the severe vulvar itching and the painful intercourse that’s been worsening over the past year.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, clay-colored, or light in color recently?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any unusually pale or clay-colored stools—my bowel movements have been normal. My main concern is still the severe vulvar itching that’s been worsening over the past year and the painful intercourse that’s progressed to the point I’ve stopped.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, such as difficulty gripping objects or opening jars?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any weakness in my hands—gripping objects and opening jars feels the same as usual. My main ongoing concern is still the severe vulvar itching and the increasing pain during intercourse.

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to remain conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t have any shaking episodes, and I haven’t lost consciousness at all. My main issue has been the severe vulvar itching that’s been steadily worsening over the past year, along with painful intercourse.

turns.doctor_question: Are you currently experiencing any pain or discomfort in your abdominal area?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t had any abdominal pain or discomfort; the main problems are the severe vulvar itching and the pain during intercourse that’s been steadily worsening over the past year. I haven’t noticed any other discomfort outside of that area.

turns.doctor_question: Are you experiencing any shortness of breath or finding it difficult to breathe?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not experiencing any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing. My main problem remains the severe vulvar itching and the painful intercourse that’s been steadily worsening over the past year.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been in contact with anyone else who has a similar rash or skin lesions?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t been in contact with anyone who has similar skin lesions or a rash. It seems to be only my own vulvar itching and pain, and I haven’t noticed any contagious-type symptoms in others around me.
